Lactate threshold report table

Source: R/report.R
lactate_report.Rd

Formats the result of lactate_threshold() as a publication-ready table: thresholds grouped by method family, with the confidence interval when available, and the checks that need attention as notes. Needs the gt package.

Usage

lactate_report(x, title = "Lactate thresholds")

Arguments

x

The result of lactate_threshold().

title

The table title, or NULL for none.

Value

a gt_tbl object (print it, or save it with gt::gtsave()).

Examples

results <- lactate_threshold(demo_data, intensity, lactate, heart_rate, plot = FALSE)
lactate_report(results)
